---
title: "FAQ"
---

## Is the manuscript source in this repository?

No. This repository was created from a strict allowlist with new Git history.
It contains only computational evidence, tutorials, notebooks, and the Pages
site. Manuscript and submission materials are maintained privately.

## Does public mean open source?

Not yet. No approved reuse license has been granted. The repository is public
for inspection and reproducibility, but all rights remain reserved until the
copyright holders add an approved license.

## Why did my hashes change after reproduction?

First compare platform and runtime fields. Scientific arrays are seeded and
validated; timing fields and platform metadata record the current run. Keep all
files from one run together before interpreting a manifest difference.

## Are these production rounding routines?

No. They are research implementations designed to expose assumptions,
certificates, and numerical identities.

## Do the experiments download data?

No. They use synthetic inputs plus the Digits dataset bundled with
scikit-learn.
